Want to know how to reduce glare from windows? Home window tinting! Below, find out how tinting your home windows is an effective solution for how to stop sun glare through windows.

Tint a Home is Australia’s most trusted window tinting network. We have been providing tinting services in Australia for over 42 years and offer a lifetime warranty on all residential applications. Our high-quality films are exclusive to us and are government certified by ARPANSA. Here is everything you need to know about how to stop sun glare through windows with window tinting:

How Window Tinting Stops Sun Glare Through Windows

Window tint is designed to reflect the sun’s rays and absorb sunlight. This is how it stops sun glare through windows. This means no more annoying reflections on screens, no more furniture or floor fading and it also keeps your home cooler during the summer months! We also have a range of films that offer other benefits too like helping to prevent break-ins, keeping your family safe from injury and adding privacy:

  • Privacy films
  • Safety film
  • Security film

And if you’d like to add an element of style to your home, we also offer decorative film – great to use as a divider. You can even customise the design!

How To Stop Sun Glare Through Windows Without Altering The Appearance Of Your Home

Because we specialise in home window tinting, we have a fantastic range of exclusive films, all with different benefits. If you would like to stop sun glare through windows but don’t want to change how your home looks we have films in lighter shades that still offer the benefit of reducing glare but without altering the appearance of your home.

Contact Us for an In-Home Quote

Use our Store Finder to find your nearest store so you can ask your local experts how to stop sun glare through windows and the films we have available to help with this or call 13 TINT to speak with our team.
